OPEN THE BLACK BOXOkay, where do the numbers come from?+

An inspectable rule-based experiment, not a trained predictor. We start with an assumed 12% daily baseline, then consider the strongest signal in each category.

+2.90Explicit reset promise
+0.45Relevant fixes
+0.30Reset hint
−1.60Cancellation / denial

A first-party commitment to reset all paid Codex users stays active for up to 36 hours; its 85% near-term floor is an editorial choice, not measured accuracy. Repeated posts do not stack. A later cancellation or completed reset retires that commitment.

P(reset) = 1 − exp(−∫ hourly_rate(t) dt)

Banked reset rule: a first-party announcement that cards are being loaded or granted counts as an observed reset event today. A future plan adds +2.20 to the hourly model and decays in 12 hours; it never confirms delivery. 100% confirms the public announcement, not delivery to your account.

Today means the remaining time before midnight in your selected timezone. Predictions are capped at 95%; 100% requires a first-party completion report or banked reset grant. Community posts appear as context but cannot confirm a reset or boost the forecast. This site cannot check your account.

We track extra Codex reset events, including banked reset grants and automatic shared resets. A banked reset is saved for later use and does not immediately refill your quota. Scheduled personal refills are separate. This page cannot see your account or reset your limits.
